_about: Settings of the enhancement engine for trio-mix-assistant, an app the owner named (the engine's docs/adr/0007). Narrow scope: rounds change only the dashboard, the docs and new tests; the safety logic, the fixtures and the ADRs are frozen; each round goes out as a pull request that GitHub merges by itself once ci-ok passes (auto-merge), and the owner's branch is fast-forwarded to main before the next round. The engine copy in tools/engine reads only this file. A worker never edits it: it is a protected path below.

protected.why: The engine, its settings, and what the checks run on. A round never changes them.
The safety logic and the app itself (console writes, holds, limits, the guard). Only the owner changes them.
Recorded fixtures: the oracles the tests compare with. Only the owner re-records them.
The checks themselves, the safety tests among them: a round may add a test, never change or delete an existing one.

dashboard.run: node app/web/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p app/web && git diff --exit-code --stat -- app/static
dashboard.why: app/static is the dashboard's compiled TypeScript: a round that changes app/web/src commits the rebuilt app/static with it

tighten.why: rule backlogs that can be lowered now

rules: Change only the dashboard (app/web/src, and the rebuilt app/static), the docs (docs/, README.md, app/*.md) and new tests under app/ts/test. Everything else is frozen; the protect step fails the round otherwise.
After changing app/web/src, rebuild app/static with: node app/web/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p app/web, and commit both.
Never change or delete an existing test; add new ones. Never touch app/ts/src, the fixtures or docs/adr.
TypeScript rules: no comments in app/ts; no 'as any', 'as unknown as' or @ts- directives; no skipped tests; erasable syntax only; never the Effect library.
Docs: plain, short sentences; say what the reader can do, not how the code works.

judge.title: the trio mix assistant's dashboard and docs
